fhwa.title: 公路隧道設計施工技術手冊
fhwa.titleEn: Technical Manual for Design and Construction of Road Tunnels—Civil Elements
fhwa.scope: 官方二〇〇九年手冊書目；工程調查、掘進與襯砌設計的背景參考，非現行個案施工規格。
fhwa.scopeEn: Official 2009 manual record; background for investigation, excavation and lining design, not a current project specification.

geo.title: 岩土指南二：場地勘察
geo.scope: 場地調查的建議良好實務及二〇一七年更新資訊；用以區分調查資料與設計推論。
geo.scopeEn: Recommended investigation practice and 2017 update information; distinguishes observations from design interpretations.

geo3.title: 岩土指南三：岩土描述
geo3.titleEn: Geoguide 3: Guide to Rock and Soil Descriptions
geo3.scope: 一九八八年第一版的官方出版紀錄，支援岩心與土岩描述術語的背景。
geo3.scopeEn: Official record of the 1988 first edition; background for consistent soil and rock logging terminology.

crossrail-geology.title: 橫貫鐵路地質縱剖面完工更新
crossrail-geology.titleEn: Crossrail Geological Long Section: Post-Construction Update
crossrail-geology.scope: 鑽孔密度、偏離路線與斷層簡化造成的地層邊界不確定性；非直接施工圖。
crossrail-geology.scopeEn: Uncertainty from borehole spacing, offset and fault simplification; the section is not a direct construction drawing.

usgs-imaging.title: 聲學與光學孔壁成像研究
usgs-imaging.titleEn: Borehole-wall imaging with acoustic and optical televiewers
usgs-imaging.scope: 政府研究者的孔壁影像與裂隙判釋研究，支援影像幾何與多資料交叉判讀。
usgs-imaging.scopeEn: Government research on borehole images and fracture interpretation, supporting image geometry and multiple evidence streams.

amberg-seismic.title: 隧道震波超前探測
amberg-seismic.scope: 儀器供應者對超前震波探測的用途說明；不以行銷範圍當作本課精度保證。
amberg-seismic.scopeEn: Instrument supplier explanation of ahead-of-face seismics; advertised ranges are not course accuracy guarantees.

isrm-stress.title: 岩體應力估計之品質控制
isrm-stress.titleEn: ISRM Suggested Methods for rock stress estimation—Part 4
isrm-stress.scope: 原研究之公開摘要與書目，說明原位應力資料品質控制；未聲稱讀取付費全文。
isrm-stress.scopeEn: Public abstract and metadata of the original methods paper on stress-estimation quality control; no claim of reading paywalled text.

isrm-methods.title: 岩石試驗建議方法完整目錄
isrm-methods.publisher: International Society for Rock Mechanics and Rock Engineering
isrm-methods.scope: 標準組織的方法清單，用以定位應力、剪力與岩石性質試驗之方法依據。
isrm-methods.scopeEn: Methods list from the professional standards organization, locating stress, shear and rock-property test guidance.

gotthard-context.title: 新阿爾卑斯鐵路連線官方介紹
gotthard-context.titleEn: New Rail Link through the Alps
gotthard-context.scope: 瑞士政府對聖哥達基線隧道規模與鐵路營運背景之公開資料。
gotthard-context.scopeEn: Swiss government background on the Gotthard Base Tunnel scale and rail operation.

crossrail-monitoring.title: 橫貫鐵路監測結案報告
crossrail-monitoring.titleEn: Instrumentation and Monitoring Close Out Reports
crossrail-monitoring.scope: 業主公開的監測資料結案與工程背景，支援監測證據及交接實務。
crossrail-monitoring.scopeEn: Owner-published monitoring close-out and engineering context, supporting evidence and handover practice.

stepney-settlement.title: 史特普尼綠地沉陷與體積損失研究
stepney-settlement.titleEn: Surface settlement and volume loss at Stepney Green
stepney-settlement.scope: 施工團隊公開的噴凝土襯砌開挖沉陷研究；本課算例獨立假設，不冒充該工程量測。
stepney-settlement.scopeEn: Project-team study of settlement during SCL excavation; course calculations are separate assumptions, not project measurements.

central-line-deformation.title: 中央線隧道誘發應變與變形
central-line-deformation.titleEn: Tunnelling induced strains and deformations at Central Line
central-line-deformation.scope: 鄰近既有隧道變形與應變的業主公開研究，用於多種量測的交叉解釋。
central-line-deformation.scopeEn: Owner-published study of movement and strain in an existing tunnel, supporting cross-interpretation of measurements.

amberg-survey.title: 隧道測量與斷面監測
amberg-survey.scope: 測量供應者對隧道斷面、變形與施工測量的公開技術分類；不作精度承諾。
amberg-survey.scopeEn: Supplier overview of tunnel profiles, deformation and construction surveying; not a course accuracy guarantee.

usgs-photogrammetry.title: 攝影測量相機系統與獨立精度檢查
usgs-photogrammetry.titleEn: Camera system considerations for geomorphic applications of SfM photogrammetry
usgs-photogrammetry.scope: 政府研究者對影像品質與獨立檢核點的研究；本課將一般幾何原理用於隧道場景，非聲稱原研究在隧道實施。
usgs-photogrammetry.scopeEn: Government research on image quality and independent check points; the course applies general geometry to tunnels, without claiming the original study was underground.

herrenknecht-epb.title: 土壓平衡潛盾原理
herrenknecht-epb.scope: 製造商公開的土倉支護、出土與土壤改良機制；不提供操作設定或配方。
herrenknecht-epb.scopeEn: Manufacturer overview of chamber support, extraction and ground conditioning, without operating settings or recipes.

herrenknecht-mixshield.title: 混合式泥水潛盾原理
herrenknecht-mixshield.scope: 製造商公開的泥水支護與氣墊壓力補償背景，供系統比較。
herrenknecht-mixshield.scopeEn: Manufacturer context on slurry support and air-cushion pressure compensation for system comparison.

sika-tbm.title: 潛盾密封與環隙填充材料的系統功能
sika-tbm.scope: 供應者公開的盾尾刷間密封及背填灌漿用途，提供物理功能背景；不引用產品數字為現場要求。
sika-tbm.scopeEn: Supplier explanation of sealing between tail brushes and annular backfill; product numbers are not adopted as field requirements.

herrenknecht-tools.title: 掘進刀具與刀盤管理
herrenknecht-tools.scope: 製造商刀具種類及刀具管理資料，支持刀盤接觸、磨耗與追溯的背景；不採用專有磨耗配方。
herrenknecht-tools.scopeEn: Manufacturer information on cutting tools and management, supporting contact, wear and traceability without proprietary wear recipes.

segment-gaskets.title: 隧道預鑄環片止水墊
segment-gaskets.scope: 供應者之鑽掘隧道環片止水墊產品分類與用途；本課另行說明教學假設。
segment-gaskets.scopeEn: Supplier classification and applications of gaskets for bored-tunnel segments; course values remain separate assumptions.

hs2-segments.title: 聯絡通道及豎井開口特殊環片設計
hs2-segments.titleEn: Special segment design for cross passages and shaft passages
hs2-segments.scope: 業主公開的特殊環片與開口受力設計文章，展示施工與永久階段須一起考慮。
hs2-segments.scopeEn: Owner-published special segment and opening design, illustrating construction and permanent load-path considerations.

crossrail-fire.title: 橫貫鐵路預鑄襯砌防火設計
crossrail-fire.titleEn: Design of Crossrail’s Precast Tunnel Linings for Fire
crossrail-fire.scope: 施工工程師公開的預鑄襯砌防火分析與試驗背景；不將案例試驗條件當成所有隧道通則。
crossrail-fire.scopeEn: Project engineers’ fire analysis and testing context for precast lining, without treating project test conditions as universal.

vmt-rings.title: 從環片生產至環組裝的品質管理
vmt-rings.titleEn: Quality management from segment production to ring building
vmt-rings.scope: 設備供應者的環片追溯、組環與品質資料背景。
vmt-rings.scopeEn: Supplier context for segment traceability, ring building and quality records.

vmt-navigation.title: 隧道掘進機導航系統
vmt-navigation.scope: 導航供應者的掘進機定位系統概覽，用於坐標鏈與姿態解釋；不承諾型錄精度。
vmt-navigation.scopeEn: Navigation supplier overview for position chains and attitude interpretation, without adopting advertised accuracy as guaranteed performance.

limitations: All numerical scenarios are original teaching assumptions; no machine operating limits or project measured values are inferred.
Source pages were searched or opened; ISRM publisher abstracts and FHWA metadata were available, not all paid or large full texts.
Approximate public map point indicates context, not an entrance or work permission.
Securities are null; no unverified ticker is shown.
Landmarks are comparison contexts; no claim is made that each taught technique occurred at both landmarks.
